thread.listingTitle: Small single room at Kangaroo Point, Brisbane

messages.text: Hey Jess! I'm Jas, a 30yo bartender from England working at a couple of bars in the Valley. This looks like such a great space and I'd be keen to come take a look at the room if you have time this coming week! I'm unfortunately being booted from my current houseshare as they're selling the place. I'm a super friendly, easygoing and respectful housemate who values a harmonious living environment 😁
